scripts.build: corepack pnpm run clean && corepack pnpm run build:client && corepack pnpm run build:artifacts && corepack pnpm run build:server && corepack pnpm run build:verify
scripts.start: corepack pnpm run runtime:check && node dist/server/server.js
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests e2e benchmark playwright.config.ts --ext .ts,.tsx
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run runtime:check && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --coverage
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm run runtime:check && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs
scripts.benchmark:quick: corepack pnpm run runtime:check && tsx benchmark/runner.ts quick
scripts.benchmark:full: corepack pnpm run runtime:check && tsx benchmark/runner.ts full
